winning_patterns: Short 13-15 second clips with high-energy streamer reactions outperform 30-second gameplay reels by 2x median views.
Hooks using all-caps promises or broken physics claims drive 10x+ views versus generic gameplay descriptions.
YouTube Shorts is the dominant traffic source for top performers, contributing 90% of views on the #1 clip despite lower TikTok volume.
avoid_patterns: Reject 30-second strip club or adult-themed scenes which generated 2-140 views and zero cross-platform traction.
Avoid generic car crash clips without a recognizable streamer reaction or specific game-breaking moment.
Do not post 30-second street gameplay reactions that lack a conflict, promise, or physics fail in the first 3 seconds.
hook_style_guidance: Write Frame-1 hooks as all-caps, promise-based statements that name a specific streamer and a broken game mechanic within the first 2 seconds.
